params.prompt: Abstract flat vector symbol for a quiet voice-capture utility. One horizontal rounded bar with a single smooth U-shaped notch cut upward into its lower edge and placed off centre, so the removed shape reads at once as a dip in a level meter and as the strip of interface the tool inhabits. Construction is a rectangle with fully rounded end caps, its height about one fifth of its width, the notch a half ellipse roughly one third of the bar's length positioned left of centre, its curve meeting the bar's underside tangentially so no sharp corner is left. Style register is spare, functional and confident, an interface component rather than a decorative badge. Strict two colour use: the locked accent fills the bar, the locked background occupies the notch, with no third colour introduced. Centred, isolated, generous even margin, the silhouette wide and stable and legible when reduced to a small interface glyph. Flat vector design, clean lines, no shadows, no texture, no text. Clean editable vector paths, SVG-friendly, minimal anchor points.

Abstract flat vector symbol for a quiet voice-capture utility. One solid circle divided into three crescent slivers of decreasing width by two curved cuts that are offset laterally rather than concentric, so the shapes read as a sound travelling sideways and thinning rather than broadcasting outward in rings. Construction is strictly circular: a single master circle, two arc subtractions sharing the circle's radius but displaced along the horizontal axis, the widest crescent at the left and the narrowest at the right, the gaps between them equal and carrying as much visual weight as the solids. Style register is disciplined, geometric and quietly technical. Strict two colour use: the locked accent fills the crescents, the locked background shows through the cuts, with no third colour introduced. Centred, isolated, generous even margin, mass distributed so the mark holds together when reduced to a small interface glyph. Flat vector design, clean lines, no shadows, no texture, no text. Clean editable vector paths, SVG-friendly, minimal anchor points.

Abstract monoline symbol for a quiet voice-capture utility. One continuous open stroke that curves inward through roughly three quarters of a turn and terminates in a single solid round dot resting inside the curve's own opening, so the enclosed negative space reads as a held breath. Construction is a single arc of constant radius with rounded caps, the dot placed off centre toward the lower right, the whole silhouette circular and balanced with deliberate asymmetry in where the stroke opens. Style register is calm, contemporary and utilitarian, closer to a precise instrument than a friendly consumer badge. Strict two colour use: the locked accent carries the stroke and the dot, the locked background sits behind as a solid field, with no third colour introduced. Centred, isolated, generous even margin, proportioned to stay legible when reduced to a small interface glyph. Monoline vector design, uniform stroke weight, rounded line caps, no fills, no shadows, no texture, no text. Clean editable vector paths, SVG-friendly, minimal anchor points.
